notes.title: Simple Patch Update
notes.notes:
Fixes include:

- Boss vulnerability timers are much more generous, but damage is now limited.
- Backstory now skippable if skip-text is on and pause button is held.
- Bearing enemy no longer fires above player hurt-box.
- Escape sequence room now blocked off after leaving next room.
- Typos in several cutscenes.

That's all, thank you!
